author: Ifmyante
text:
Lovely work brother

One thing to beware of however: I saw you took a few trades in one day on GBP/others. If GBP is driving the market, that is effectively taking the same trade a number of times at once. Just be careful not to overexpose yourself in situations like this. If one of the trades fails, the others are likely to fail too.

Apart from that, beautiful work!

author: Kovalenko
text:
Thanks IF (mate) for these words, very much appreciated.

Yeah, I totally agree with you. No need to take many deals in one day. It`s better – to choose the best trades, although I saw in these trades that they were the best.

You know, your words - With time, patience and experience, what once seemed very complex becomes very simple indeed – now I understand that these words have deep sense. Thank you very much!

IF – it`s for you, mate!
